Create a spacious medieval Scandinavian village of roughly seven raised log buildings around a broad central yard on an irregular muddy patch surrounded by meadow and distant low hills. Connect the buildings with curving, branching rutted paths. Use dark log walls, pale plank gables, steep thatch, small windows, porches, stairs, and timber-post foundations. Place the largest decorated hall at one edge facing inward, with smaller cabins at varied angles. Add partial split-rail garden or animal enclosures, a few grazing animals, a firepit, benches, tables, carts, logs, barrels, and baskets beside porches and paths. Keep the center open, with denser grasses and wildflowers toward the perimeter and light chimney smoke.
